PLAN2 insertion QC panels (C4)

Columns: host hemisphere before | after pasting | donor it came from. Rows: T1, T2. Yellow line = pasted region.

Check each panel: (1) the pasted region sits inside the host brain; (2) its brightness roughly matches the host (no obvious bright or dark block); (3) the edge does not look like a hard cut-out square; (4) for shams, the region should look like ordinary healthy tissue, not a tumour.

Note anything that looks wrong by panel number.
